claims.claim_text: DSA strongly disapproves of U.S. sanctions against Venezuelan officials enacted in 2014, their subsequent three-year extension and President Obama's March 2015 Executive Order 13692 declaring Venezuela a national-security threat.
DSA describes its activists as committed to fighting for socialism and democracy in the United States and worldwide.
DSA declares solidarity with the people of Venezuela.
DSA calls on the U.S. government to repeal the 2014 legislation imposing sanctions on Venezuelan officials and the subsequent sanctions extension described in its May 30, 2016 statement.
DSA calls on the U.S. government to reverse President Obama's March 2015 Executive Order 13692 declaring Venezuela a national-security threat.
